explication: Unitree RL Lab trains and evaluates reinforcement-learning locomotion and motion-mimic policies in Isaac Lab, then runs exported policies through C++ robot controllers for MuJoCo or physical Unitree robots. The main workflow is task selection → simulated environment → observations and rewards → PPO training or inference → deployment FSM → robot commands. The deployment internals are sampled directly; Python task wiring and some controller details are represented from the tree and README, so uncertain call edges are omitted.
